title: Vaseline unveils first facial skin care range to target sun-induced melasma
summary: The Unilever-owned brand is breaking into the therapeutic facial skin care category with Pro Derma Melasma Repair, a range backed by 12 years of research and formulated with Glycoxome technology to target sun-induced melasma at the point of formation
